meaning:
A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.31;
father of: Ethan (H0387), Heman (H1968), Calcol (H3633), Darda (H1862)
§ Mahol = "dancing"
father of Heman

elsewhere.note: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations all around.
